proposal.label: needs reproducible example
proposal.comment: Could you share a small, shareable CSV file (or pasteable sample) that still triggers the conversion error, together with the complete error message produced by the `read_csv` call? Also confirm the exact `read_csv` command you ran (including working directory) and whether any file encoding or delimiter differs from defaults.
proposal.rationale: The report omits the CSV contents/sample and the full error message; without a reproducer and the precise error text we cannot follow or diagnose the failure.
